title: Lesson Exposure Event
description: A sibling event type to the attempt event, NOT an attempt (student-model doc §9). Logged whenever a lesson plays, so the core doc's lesson-efficacy loop (§6.3 — post-lesson first-attempt success, script A/B, no-lesson holdout) is computable. Practice attempts join against the most recent exposure for their skill; exposure assignment is the one datum no later cleverness can reconstruct.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier, for joining and ordering alongside attempt events.

session_id.description: Session identifier, matching the attempt-event schema (§9).

lesson_id.description: The lesson that played, e.g. LSN.FRAC.ADD.UNLIKE.NCERT.v1 (§9; core doc §6.2).

lesson_variant.description: The lesson variant played — pedagogy variant and/or script version (§9; core doc §6.2).

skill_id.description: Skill the lesson teaches; practice attempts join against the most recent exposure for their skill (§9).

segments_completed.description: How many of the lesson's segments the student watched to completion (§9; core doc §6.1 defines 4 segments).

ab_arm.description: The A/B assignment arm — script A vs script B, or the small no-lesson holdout (§9; core doc §6.3).
